title: runApi
responsibility: Executes API CLI commands and delivers JSON, selected fields or exact file bytes.

inputs.name: runApi.operation
inputs.description: Selects the command dispatched by the workflow. Supported names are resources, connect, screenshot, get, request, contract, providers, cancel, events, define, start, and call; any other string raises ExpectedCliError.

inputs.name: runApi.args
inputs.description: Provides positional strings consumed by the selected command; some commands ignore this array. Required positions vary by command, and handlers access entries directly, so a missing position can fail during dispatch.

inputs.name: runApi.options
inputs.description: Provides the options passed to HarnessApiService and apiOutput. The request command reads query and input, while screenshot output formatting receives a copy with output set to undefined; the declared shape is HarnessApiOptions.

outputs.name: runApi
outputs.description: Resolves after the selected command runs and its result is passed to apiOutput. The promise carries no return value.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised by fail when operation is not an own key of the command dispatch map. This check runs before the selected command handler.
